```yaml
name: Bump openinference-instrumentation version

on:
  release:
    types: [published]
    # This workflow is intended to be triggered when a new release of
    # openinference-instrumentation is published. The event payload
    # contains the tag name of the new release in `github.event.release.tag_name`.

jobs:
  bump:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"

      - name: Update openinference-instrumentation dependency
        run: |
          NEW_VERSION="${{ github.event.release.tag_name }}"
          echo "Bumping openinference-instrumentation to ${NEW_VERSION}"
          # Find all pyproject.toml files in instrumentor packages
          find . -type f -name 'pyproject.toml' -print0 | while IFS= read -r -d '' file; do
            # Update the dependency line, preserving any existing upper bound
            sed -i -E "s/(openinference-instrumentation[<>=]*)([0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+)(.*)/\\1${NEW_VERSION}\\3/" "$file"
          done
          # Also update any setup.cfg or requirements.txt files if present
          find . -type f \( -name 'setup.cfg' -o -name 'requirements.txt' \) -print0 | while IFS= read -r -d '' file; do
            sed -i -E "s/(openinference-instrumentation[<>=]*)([0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+)(.*)/\\1${NEW_VERSION}\\3/" "$file"
          done

      - name: Commit and push changes
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v5
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          commit-message: "chore: bump openinference-instrumentation to ${{ github.event.release.tag_name }}"
          branch: "bump-openinference-instrumentation-${{ github.event.release.tag_name }}"
          title: "chore: bump openinference-instrumentation to ${{ github.event.release.tag_name }}"
          body: |
            This PR updates the minimum version of **openinference-instrumentation** to `${{ github.event.release.tag_name }}` across all Python instrumentor packages.
            It ensures that all dependencies are aligned with the latest release.
          labels: "chore"
```
